ops.text: Use pnpm for all package management in this repo. Never run npm install, and never create or commit a package-lock.json.
Store monetary amounts as integer cents, never floats. Convert with toCents and format with formatCents from src/lib/money.ts.
Do not add new UI libraries. Build UI with the project's own components in src/ui (Select, Dialog, Button) and never install headless UI packages such as @headlessui/react.
New blog posts must have `draft: true` in frontmatter until the user reviews them; never set `draft: false` yourself.
Post images go in public/images/<post-slug>/ and must be .webp format; do not place post images under src/assets.
Place unit tests next to the file they test, e.g. src/domain/budget.test.ts. Never create __tests__ folders.
Never hand-edit files in src/api/generated. They are generated from openapi.yaml. To change the API, edit openapi.yaml and run pnpm gen:api.
Use npm, not pnpm, in this project (package-lock.json is present): install packages with `npm install <pkg>` and never create or keep pnpm-lock.yaml.
Keep business logic out of components: put calculations in src/domain and expose them to components through a hook in src/hooks.
Store dates in UTC and convert them through src/lib/dates.ts (date-fns-tz, user's timezone) for display and comparisons. Never compare dates using local new Date() values.
Default the app currency to GBP (UK product). Use British English for all UI copy, e.g. 'colour', 'categorise', 'organisation'.
Never use emojis in post content, including headings; keep headings plain text.
Before saying a task is done, run `pnpm lint` and `pnpm typecheck` and fix any failures, since CI fails on lint.
Never commit or push changes in this repo unless the user explicitly asks. Leave all work uncommitted so the user can review the diff.
Store monetary amounts as integer cents, never floats. Convert only with toCents and format only with formatCents from src/lib/money.ts; never use toFixed or *100 math on amounts.
Default the app currency to GBP (UK product). Use British English for all UI copy, e.g. 'colour', 'categorise', 'organisation'.
Never add UI libraries such as @headlessui/react; build UI from src/ui components (Select, Dialog, Button) and never use window.confirm or alert.
Post images go in public/images/<post-slug>/ and must be .webp format; do not place post images under src/assets.
